title: Concrete strength: the power to catch a weak mix
intro: A concrete mix is specified at **4000 psi**. Strength has σ = 300 psi. The engineer breaks **n = 9** cylinders and tests H₀: μ = 4000 against H₁: μ < 4000 at α = 0.05. If the mix were really **3750 psi**, how likely is the test to catch it? And how many cylinders would give a **90 %** chance? (This sample's mean, 3870 psi, decides this test but does not change the power.)
